note: Hand-verified corrections where the PUBLISHER'S OWN Crossref deposit is wrong. Normalisation cannot fix these -- the string is recorded faithfully and is simply not true. `corrections` fixes one author on one paper; `blanket` pins a person for the whole period this index covers, so a re-harvest that re-introduces a misaligned deposit cannot silently reopen it. Every entry states its evidence.

corrections.evidence: IEEE's deposit for 'Tensor Algebra Compilation with Workspaces' (CGO 2019) shifted affiliations by one position: Kjolstad MIT, Ahrens MIT, Kamil Adobe Research, Amarasinghe Adobe Research. Kamil is the Adobe author; Amarasinghe inherited his address. Ruled by Saman 2026-08-19.

blanket.evidence: Ruled by Saman 2026-08-19: MIT for the whole period this index covers.
